# spec-kitty-basic

Spec Kitty (017) engine world: the `kitty-specs/` two-mission roll-up layout (8 printed
`Txxx` subtasks) driving the identity-agnostic engine lifecycle — bootstrap plan, full
apply, idempotent re-plan, and total-restoration rollback — proving the engine suites
accept the sixth built-in identity with the same results shape as the five pre-existing
identities (SC-005). Single route: both missions default to `TEAM-A`/`proj-alpha`.
